title: Pulse
description: One install's daily usage record (decision 0020 d16; RULINGS_FOR_MH section 21): one per install per UTC day, sent to our reports server through the same Worker, the same switch (reports.auto) and the same install reference as cases. Two closed shapes: the record (reports on) and the heartbeat (reports off: the install reference and the date, nothing else). Never a balance, an address, an order or gcx's version. Passes the last check of d4.5 like a case. Version 1; a new field is additive and optional and needs a schema addition, never a policy.

dashboard.description: The Dashboard was opened that day (active user): the panel's POST /api/v1/usage/dashboard set the day's row.

where.description: Where gcx runs (decision 0024 d15), under the same switch as the rest of the record. Optional, added in the build that follows the Worker's deploy: a record without it is as valid as ever. Never the browser's full user agent, the computer's name, the screen, the language, the time zone or gcx's version.

shell.description: mac: the Mac app's helper runs the runtime; windows: the Windows app's helper (GCXTray.exe) does; docker: the image (GCX_SHELL=docker); node: gcx started by hand or by the person's own unit. A later shell adds its own value.

os.description: System name and release, as case.schema.json header.os, e.g. darwin 25.1.0.

arch.description: The chip type, as case.schema.json header.arch.

browser.description: The family of the browser that last opened the Dashboard that day, reduced at once from its User-Agent (the agent is never stored or sent); absent on a day the Dashboard did not open.

keyStoreLocked.description: A start that day went on with gcx's key store not yet open (unlock-retry): its unlock was slow or failed. Optional, absent on a day every start opened it in time; under the same switch as the rest of the record, and sent only after the Worker's deploy that learns it.

resources.description: What gcx's runtime process uses when the record is built (decision 0030 amendment 3 section 3), under the same switch as the rest of the record. Optional: a record without it is as valid as ever.

rssMb.description: Its resident memory, in whole MB.

cpuSeconds.description: The processor time it used since it started (user and system), in whole seconds.

uptimeSeconds.description: The time since it started, in whole seconds.

venues.description: One entry per venue or chain with something to say; demo accounts and testnet never counted.

venue.description: hyperliquid today; solana and others when built.

live.description: A bot ran or an order of gcx's rested on this venue at any moment of the day (active trader, wide).

created.description: The person or their agent created a bot or an order on this venue that day; a bot's own orders do not count (active sender, narrow).

volume.description: Per quote currency: the sum of price x size of the day's fills of orders gcx placed on this venue, summed with Dec, exact, fees excluded.

quote.description: The instruments' quote asset, e.g. USDC.

oneOf.description: The heartbeat (section 21 (5)): reports are off; this install exists and sends nothing else.

tier.description: The tier the copy says it is (0030 amendments 1 and 2), as case.schema.json header.tier, so a record from an internal tester is told from one that touches production. Optional: absent when the copy reads none; on the heartbeat too.

install.description: The install reference of case.schema.json header.install: the first 32 hex digits of SHA-256("gcx-case-install:" + installId).

day.description: The UTC day the record covers.
